The stock has fallen 5.91% over the past month, lagging the Basic Materials sector's 11.88% gain. However, analysts project strong earnings growth of 108.39% YoY and revenue growth of 27.4% for the upcoming quarter. headlines.title: Centrus Energy (LEU) Down 4.3% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Rebound?
headlines.summary: Centrus Energy's stock has declined 4.3% since its Q2 2026 earnings report, underperforming the S&P 500. While the company beat EPS estimates and reported 14% revenue growth to $176.1 million driven by uranium sales, profitability was pressured by a 25% increase in cost of sales and a 96% surge in SG&A expenses related to expansion efforts. Operating income plunged 69% year-over-year, though the company maintains its 2026 revenue guidance of $450-$500 million and a substantial $4.5 billion backlog extending to 2040. Analyst estimates have trended downward with a -98.21% consensus shift, and the stock carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

headlines.title: DOW's Shares Rally 30% YTD: What's Driving the Momentum?
headlines.summary: Dow Inc. (DOW) shares have gained 29.9% year-to-date, outperforming the chemicals industry's 22% increase. The company is driving growth through cost-reduction initiatives, specialty silicones expansion, and alkoxylation investments. Dow expects over $1.3 billion in self-help benefits in 2026, including $700 million from its new 'Transform to Outperform' initiative. The company carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

headlines.title: Freeport-McMoRan (FCX) Stock Falls Amid Market Uptick: What Investors Need to Know
headlines.summary: Freeport-McMoRan stock declined 1.85% to $72.56 while broader markets gained, underperforming the S&P 500's 1.06% rise and the Basic Materials sector's 12.41% gain over the past month. Despite expected EPS growth of 46% and full-year earnings projected at $2.81 per share (+58.76% YoY), the company holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with a Forward P/E of 26.27, trading near industry average valuations.

headlines.title: Orion (OEC) Down 21.5% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Rebound?
headlines.summary: Orion (OEC) reported Q2 2026 adjusted earnings of 14 cents per share, beating consensus by 27.3%, with net sales rising 7.4% year-over-year to $500.9 million. However, shares have declined 21.5% since the earnings report. The Specialty Carbon Black segment showed strength with 96% EBITDA growth, while Rubber Carbon Black segment EBITDA fell 60.7% due to lower contractual pricing and softer tire production. The company reaffirmed its 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance of $170-$210 million and raised free cash flow guidance. Analyst estimates have shifted downward 28.57% in the past month, and the stock holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) with a VGM Score of B.

headlines.title: Why Is Mosaic (MOS) Up 10.1% Since Last Earnings Report?

The class period runs from February 27, 2025 to July 8, 2026, with a deadline of September 28, 2026 for investors to participate.

The lead plaintiff deadline is September 28, 2026. Similar class action notices are being issued for PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation (PRCT) and Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. (HTZ).

AMGN.title: AMGN's MariTide: Can Convenience Drive its Obesity Market Share?
AMGN.summary: Amgen's MariTide is entering a competitive obesity market dominated by Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly. The drug showed up to 20% average weight loss in phase II trials and offers a key advantage with once-monthly or less-frequent dosing compared to weekly injections from competitors. While MariTide trails competitors' efficacy and market presence, the massive obesity market projected to reach $114 billion by 2030 could support multiple players, allowing MariTide to carve out a meaningful position based on convenience and adherence.

AZN.summary: Pacira (PCRX) reported Q2 2026 adjusted earnings of 73 cents per share, beating consensus estimates of 64 cents, with revenues of $192.4 million exceeding expectations. Despite the earnings beat, estimates have been trending downward, and the stock received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating with expectations for in-line returns.

AZN.title: Krystal Biotech (KRYS) Up 12% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Continue?

AZN.title: AZN Stock Down 20% in 6 Months: How to Play After Pipeline Setbacks
AZN.summary: AstraZeneca's stock has fallen 19.5% in six months due to several clinical and pipeline setbacks, including failed studies for Wainua and Ultomiris, and FDA delays for camizestrant. However, the company maintains solid fundamentals with 16 blockbuster drugs, 15% oncology sales growth, and targets $80 billion in revenues by 2030 with 20 new medicines planned. Despite headwinds from patent expirations and China market uncertainties, analysts recommend staying invested given growth prospects.

AZN.title: AZN's Tagrisso Plus Orpathys Study in First-Line NSCLC Meets Goal
AZN.summary: AstraZeneca announced positive Phase III SANOVO study results showing that Tagrisso (osimertinib) combined with Orpathys (savolitinib) significantly improved progression-free survival versus Tagrisso monotherapy in treatment-naïve patients with EGFR-mutated advanced NSCLC with MET overexpression. The combination also demonstrated encouraging overall survival improvements. These results could expand the clinical utility of the combination to first-line treatment settings.

DSS.title: DSS, Inc. Announces Decision Not to Proceed with Proposed Public Offering
DSS.summary: DSS, Inc. announced on September 4, 2026, that it has decided not to proceed with its previously announced public offering of Common Stock due to limited capacity under its existing shelf registration statement. The company continues to explore alternative capital-raising options while remaining focused on shareholder value creation.

DSS.title: DSS, Inc. Announces Launch of Proposed Public Offering
DSS.summary: DSS, Inc. announced the commencement of a public offering of Common Stock on the NYSE American under ticker DSS. The company intends to use net proceeds for general corporate and working capital needs. Aegis Capital Corp. is serving as the sole book-running manager. The offering is subject to market conditions and completion is not assured.

NTLA.title: Intellia Therapeutics Secures Non-Dilutive Debt Facility with OrbiMed for up to $400 Million
NTLA.summary: Intellia Therapeutics announced a $400 million non-dilutive senior secured term loan facility with OrbiMed, consisting of $75 million upfront and $325 million tied to milestones. The financing provides strategic flexibility as the company advances toward U.S. approval and commercial launch of lonvo-z for hereditary angioedema treatment, while also supporting advancement of nexiguran ziclumeran in transthyretin amyloidosis.

NTLA.title: Intellia Therapeutics to Present at Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference
NTLA.summary: Intellia Therapeutics reported positive Phase 3 HAELO clinical data for lonvo-z in HAE, with results presented at EAACI and published in the New England Journal of Medicine. The company anticipates FDA acceptance of a BLA (Biologics License Application) for lonvo-z in the second half of 2026.

GPRO.title: GPRO Stock Alert: Halper Sadeh LLC is Investigating Whether GoPro, Inc. is Obtaining a Fair Price for its Shareholders
GPRO.summary: Investor rights law firm Halper Sadeh LLC is investigating GoPro's proposed sale to Starman Optical for $1.14 per share. The firm questions whether the board obtained the best price, conducted a fair sales process, and made adequate disclosures to shareholders. The investigation suggests potential conflicts of interest and insider benefits that may not be available to ordinary shareholders.

NNOX.title: Nanox Signs Distribution Agreement with Associated X-Ray Imaging to Expand Nanox.ARC Adoption Across New England
NNOX.summary: Nanox announced a distribution agreement with Associated X-Ray Imaging Corp., a New England-based medical imaging provider, to expand deployment of the Nanox.ARC, an FDA-cleared 3D digital tomosynthesis system, across the region. The partnership leverages Associated X-Ray Imaging's established regional presence and service infrastructure to support Nanox's U.S. commercial expansion in outpatient and community-based clinical settings.

INTC.title: Memory Costs Rise: Can NVIDIA Protect Its 70%+ Gross Margin?

However, the company received a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating due to unfavorable estimate revision trends. The stock has underperformed the S&P 500 by 23.2% year-to-date. ZS.title: Gigamon Appoints Grant Yacomeni as Chief Information Security Officer
ZS.summary: Gigamon announced the appointment of Grant Yacomeni as Chief Information Security Officer. IOVA.summary: DelveInsight released a comprehensive analysis of the advanced endometrial cancer clinical trial pipeline, identifying 25+ active pharmaceutical companies developing 26+ pipeline drugs. The report highlights emerging therapies including immunotherapies, targeted agents, and antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) from major players like Pfizer, Genmab, and Incyte Corporation. Recent developments include FDA Fast Track designation for Faeth Therapeutics' PIKTOR combination therapy and positive Phase III results for Merck's sacituzumab tirumotecan, indicating significant momentum in reshaping the advanced endometrial cancer treatment landscape.

SEZL.summary: Sezzle has expanded its merchant network by adding Gymshark, Debenhams Group, and Follett Higher Education, gaining access to 7.5 million students and diverse consumer segments. SNOW.summary: U.S. stock markets rose on Thursday as Treasury yields declined globally, easing Fed rate hike concerns. MRK.title: Does Moderna's mRNA Flu Shot Face a New Challenge From GSK?

While GSK's vaccine is still years away from market approval, it could pose a competitive challenge to Moderna's mFlusiva, which currently targets only HA like traditional flu vaccines.

MRK.title: Why Is Merck (MRK) Up 18.2% Since Last Earnings Report?

However, the company lowered its full-year adjusted EPS guidance to $2.66-$2.76 from $5.04-$5.16 due to acquisition-related charges from the Terns Pharmaceuticals deal. Key growth drivers included Keytruda sales up 4% to $8.37B and Winrevair surging 75% to $588M, but Januvia/Janumet declined 31%. MRK.title: AZN Stock Down 20% in 6 Months: How to Play After Pipeline Setbacks

However, the company maintains solid fundamentals with 16 blockbuster drugs, 15% oncology sales growth, and targets $80 billion in revenues by 2030 with 20 new medicines planned. MRK.title: Can LLY's Merida Deal Boost Its M&A Push to Diversify Beyond GLP-1s?

Other major pharma companies including Merck, Gilead Sciences, and AbbVie are also pursuing significant M&A deals to expand pipelines and enter new therapeutic areas.

BILI.summary: Bilibili announced a $700 million convertible senior notes offering due 2031, with $200 million subscribed by Tencent. DD.title: Vulcanised Fibre Market Size to Reach USD 2.85 Billion by 2035 Growing at 5.01% CAGR | SNS Insider
DD.summary: The global vulcanized fibre market, valued at USD 1.75 billion in 2025, is projected to reach USD 2.85 billion by 2035 with a CAGR of 5.01%. Growth is driven by rising demand for high-performance insulating materials in electrical and automotive sectors, particularly from electric vehicle manufacturing. The U.S. market is expected to reach USD 0.79 billion by 2035, while Europe reaches USD 0.78 billion, with Asia-Pacific emerging as the fastest-growing region.

SAP.title: Product Information Management Market Size to Surpass $69.49 Billion by 2035 | SNS Insider
SAP.summary: The global Product Information Management (PIM) market is expected to grow from $16.88 billion in 2025 to $69.49 billion by 2035, with a CAGR of 15.2%. North America leads with 39% market share, while Asia-Pacific is the fastest-growing region. Large enterprises dominate with 68% share, with retail being the leading vertical at 32%. Cloud-based solutions are experiencing the fastest growth due to scalability and cost-effectiveness.

BEKAY.title: Bekaert: Update on the Share Buyback Program and the Liquidity Agreement
BEKAY.summary: Bekaert repurchased 57,236 shares during the week of 27 August to 2 September 2026 under its €75 million buyback program, with an average price of €38.49 per share. Additionally, under its liquidity agreement with Kepler Cheuvreux, Bekaert bought 3,558 shares and sold 3,020 shares during the same period. As of 2 September 2026, Bekaert holds 2,151,258 own shares, representing 4.30% of outstanding shares.

BEKAY.title: Bekaert: Update over het Inkoopprogramma van Eigen Aandelen en de Liquiditeitsovereenkomst
BEKAY.summary: Bekaert repurchased 57,236 shares during August 27 - September 2, 2026, as part of its €75 million buyback program announced in February 2026. JYSKY.title: Ændringer i koncerndirektionen
JYSKY.summary: Bankdirektør Peter Schleidt will retire at the end of September 2026 after nearly a decade leading digitalization and operations at Jyske Bank. JYSKY.summary: Jyske Bank announces that COO Peter Schleidt will retire at the end of September 2026 after nearly a decade of contributions to operations and digitalization. VIELF.title: VIEL ET COMPAGNIE : CROISSANCE DES RESULTATS AU 1er SEMESTRE 2026 : Chiffre d’affaires consolidé en hausse de 6,5%, Résultat d’exploitation  en progression de 7,2%, Résultat net en hausse de 11,6%

RBLX.title: 9-Year-Old Hip Hop Sensation Young Roddo Shot the First Official Music Video Ever Made in Roblox
RBLX.summary: Young Roddo, a 9-year-old artist signed to EMPIRE, released the first official music video filmed entirely within Roblox, specifically in the Brookhaven experience. DECK.title: Deckers' Expanding DTC Business Supports a Favorable Sales Mix
DECK.summary: Deckers Outdoor Corporation's direct-to-consumer (DTC) business grew 13% to $352.8 million in Q1 fiscal 2027, significantly outpacing 2.2% wholesale growth. HOKA led the expansion with 17.3% revenue growth, while UGG contributed 5.7% growth. The stronger DTC channel mix helped expand gross margins by 60 basis points to 56.4%. Management projects continued significant DTC growth in fiscal 2027, with consolidated revenues expected between $5.86-$5.91 billion.

OSIS.title: OSI SYSTEMS, INC. INVESTOR ALERT: Kirby McInerney LLP Announces Investigation Into Potential Securities Fraud
OSIS.summary: Law firm Kirby McInerney LLP is investigating OSI Systems for potential securities fraud following the company's August 20, 2026 earnings report. OSI reported Q4 2026 revenue of $484.1 million, missing analyst expectations by 8.5% and declining 4.1% year-over-year. The company attributed the shortfall to $50 million in delayed Security division deliveries due to Middle East conflicts. OSI's stock fell 5.21% to $206.73 per share on August 21, 2026.

OSIS.title: NVT Trades at Premium Valuation: Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?

FCEL.summary: Law firm Kirby McInerney LLP is investigating FuelCell Energy for potential securities fraud following the company's disclosure of $17 million in inventory charges and losses on its Fit Energy agreement. Operating expenses spiked 46% year-over-year, with non-GAAP S&M expenses surging 88%, causing operating margins to collapse from 21% to 5%. Management acknowledged competitive challenges and product gaps during earnings calls.

CRCT.title: Cricut® Introduces Cricut Maker® 5, Its Most Versatile Smart Cutting Machine Yet
CRCT.summary: Cricut, Inc. announced the Cricut Maker 5, its next-generation smart cutting machine featuring expanded material capabilities (up to 3mm thickness, 25% increase), advanced engraving features, and a 30% more compact design. The machine is compatible with over 300 materials and 13 specialized tools. Available starting September 4, 2026, with bundles starting at $349, the Maker 5 will launch exclusively through Cricut.com and Michaels stores for the first two weeks.

CRCT.title: New Strong Buy Stocks for September 3rd
CRCT.summary: Zacks has added five stocks to its Rank #1 (Strong Buy) list based on significant increases in consensus earnings estimates over the last 60 days. PLAB.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Photronics, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
PLAB.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Photronics, Inc. alleging that the company made materially false and misleading statements regarding demand for its high-end IC photomask products. The complaint claims Photronics concealed a significant bottleneck in its design release pipeline that constrained growth and overstated the sustainability of favorable order patterns. ADDYY.title: Is DKS Cheap Enough to Offset Foot Locker and Margin Execution Risks?
ADDYY.summary: DICK'S Sporting Goods trades at a valuation discount (10.41X forward earnings vs. 12.7X historical median) following a 39.5% stock decline. While the core DICK'S business showed strong 4.9% comparable sales growth, the acquired Foot Locker division is struggling with a projected $40-$80 million operating loss in fiscal 2026 due to weak footwear demand and promotional pressures. Margin compression from Foot Locker mix, athletic promotions, and higher costs further pressures profitability. Despite cost synergy opportunities, execution risks remain elevated in a promotional market.

ORRF.summary: Orrstown Financial Services (ORRF) is highlighted as a compelling income investment opportunity with a dividend yield of 2.85%, outperforming its industry average of 2.18%. LUNR.title: Can LUNR Turn Its $1.8 Billion Backlog into Stronger 2026 Results?
LUNR.summary: Intuitive Machines (LUNR) ended Q2 2026 with a record $1.8B backlog after booking $920M in awards, but revenues missed estimates at $206.2M despite 310% YoY growth. The company expects 25-30% of backlog to convert to 2026 revenue and maintained its $900M-$1B full-year guidance. However, operating losses widened due to elevated expenses and a $14.7M charge on the IM-4 lunar mission, highlighting execution risks and the critical importance of second-half conversion to meet targets.

LUNR.title: LUNR Falls 46.4% in 3 Months. Is the Sell-Off a Buying Opportunity?
LUNR.summary: Intuitive Machines (LUNR) has declined 46.4% over three months despite achieving a record $1.8B backlog and booking $920M in Q2 2026 awards. While the company shows strong operational expansion with 70+ IM-300 spacecraft under contract and improving satellite production, it faces headwinds from fixed-price lunar mission risks, negative adjusted EBITDA, and a premium valuation multiple relative to peers. The stock carries a Hold rating with weak value, growth, and momentum scores, suggesting investors should await execution improvements rather than treating the decline as a buying opportunity.

LUNR.title: Is LUNR Worth Buying as Growth Accelerates but Valuation Stays Rich?
LUNR.summary: Intuitive Machines (LUNR) reported Q2 revenues of $206.2 million, up 310% year-over-year, with a record $1.8 billion backlog and diversified revenue streams across civil, commercial, and national security sectors. However, the stock trades at a premium valuation (3.15X forward sales vs. 2.38X sub-industry average) while the company remains unprofitable, faces cash burn of $59.8 million quarterly, and has margin risks from fixed-price contracts. Analysts maintain a Hold rating, suggesting investors await better execution visibility before aggressive entry.

ACIU.title: FDA Accepts UTHR's sNDA for Tyvaso in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis
ACIU.summary: United Therapeutics announced FDA acceptance of a supplemental new drug application for nebulized Tyvaso to treat idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), with a regulatory decision expected in late April 2027. The TETON phase III studies demonstrated statistically significant improvements in lung function, including a 111.8 mL FVC benefit, reduced clinical worsening, and favorable secondary endpoints. If approved, Tyvaso would be the first FDA-approved inhaled anti-fibrotic treatment for IPF.

Growth is driven by increasing demand for sustainable, bio-based formulations in personal care, cosmetics, and detergents. Natural fatty alcohols dominate with 68.2% market share, while Asia Pacific leads globally with 46.8% of market value. Key developments include Kao's agreement to secure NALO production capacity as a palm oil alternative.

PG.title: Global Skin Care Products Market is Expected to Surpass the USD 260 Billion Mark by 2034 | DelveInsight
PG.summary: The global skin care products market is projected to grow from USD 166 billion in 2025 to USD 262 billion by 2034, with a CAGR of approximately 5%. Growth is driven by rising consumer awareness of skin health, increasing disposable incomes, demand for premium and personalized products, and the influence of social media trends. Asia-Pacific leads with 38% market share, while North America is the fastest-growing region. Key players include L'Oréal, Unilever, Procter & Gamble, and Estée Lauder.

PG.title: Procter & Gamble Fabric & Home Care Trends Mixed: Is Growth Ahead?
PG.summary: Procter & Gamble's Fabric & Home Care segment displays mixed performance with Fabric Care showing low-single digit growth while Home Care declined in Q4 fiscal 2026. The company faces competitive pressure in Europe but is seeing improvement in U.S. Fabric Care momentum and China share growth. Innovation initiatives like Tide upgrades and Mr. Clean expansions are driving growth, though the segment remains a concern overall.

SMTC.title: Bull of the Day: Semtech (SMTC)
SMTC.summary: Semtech (SMTC), a $12 billion semiconductor supplier, is positioned as a pivotal player in AI infrastructure and optical interconnects. Following a strong earnings beat in August with EPS estimates raised over 30% for the current year and 50% for next year, the company benefits from demand for high-speed optical transceivers and data center solutions. Operating through three segments—Signal Integrity, Analog Mixed Signal, and IoT Systems—Semtech serves hyperscalers and industrial markets, with Greater China representing 47% of sales.

FLIDY.title: FLSmidth to establish fourth business line focused on crushing, sizing & screening to support its strategic growth journey
FLIDY.summary: FLSmidth announces the establishment of a fourth business line, the Crushing, Sizing & Screening (CSS) Business Line, effective January 1, 2027. Alanas Kraujalis will lead the new CSS Business Line, while Petri Virrankoski will join as President of the Service Business Line. HGTY.title: BROAD ARROW PRESENTS ULTIMATE PERFORMANCE CARS AT ITS SECOND ANNUAL ZÜRICH AUCTION
HGTY.summary: Broad Arrow Auctions, driven by Hagerty, is hosting its second annual Zürich Auction on November 7, 2026, at the Dolder Grand. FTRE.title: Fortrea Akan Mengakuisisi Unit Farmakologi Klinis dan Operasional Laboratorium Bionalitik dari Worldwide Clinical Trials
FTRE.summary: Fortrea has signed a definitive agreement to acquire the Early Phase Services division from Worldwide Clinical Trials for approximately $45 million. This deal strengthens Fortrea's early-stage clinical development platform and integrated capabilities, while allowing Worldwide to focus on its faster-growing late-stage business across oncology, neuroscience, and rare diseases.

FTRE.summary: Fortrea has agreed to acquire the Early Phase Services division of Worldwide Clinical Trials for approximately $45 million in an all-cash transaction. CHKP.title: Varonis (VRNS) Surges 10.4%: Is This an Indication of Further Gains?
CHKP.summary: Varonis Systems (VRNS) stock jumped 10.4% to $46.76, driven by strong SaaS business growth with ARR rising 25% year-over-year to $598.1 million. REBN.title: Reborn Coffee Receives Nasdaq Notification Regarding Late 10-Q Filing and Continued Listing Requirements

ALAR.title: התראה על מועד אחרון לתביעה ייצוגית נגד GPGI, CMPO: רוזן, משרד עורכי דין לליטיגציה, קורא למשקיעי GPGI, Inc. f/k/a CompoSecure, Inc. שספגו הפסדים העולים על 100,000 דולר, לשכור ייצוג משפטי לקראת המועד האחרון החשוב ב- 14 בספטמבר בתביעה ייצוגית בניירות ערך – GPGI, CMPO

ALAR.title: ROSEN, SKILLED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Alarum Technologies Ltd. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action First Filed by the Firm - ALAR
ALAR.summary: Rosen Law Firm is seeking lead plaintiffs for a securities class action lawsuit against Alarum Technologies Ltd. (ALAR) for allegedly making false statements about its business. The lawsuit claims that Alarum's subsidiary NetNut was engaging in illegal activity by linking customer home internet devices into another network without consent, enabling cybercriminals to conceal their locations. The firm alleges defendants failed to disclose this illegal activity and its material impact on the company's legal exposure and business prospects. The lead plaintiff deadline is October 5, 2026.

SIGEY.title: Sigenergy Ranks #1 Globally in S&P Global Energy H1 2026 Residential Energy Storage Market Tracker
SIGEY.summary: Sigenergy has achieved the No. 1 global ranking by MWh shipments in residential energy storage (H1 2026) with 14% market share, according to S&P Global Energy's tracker. The company has expanded its global network to over 170 distributors and 25,000+ installers across 120+ countries. Following its Hong Kong Stock Exchange listing in April 2026, Sigenergy launched four major product breakthroughs including SigenStor Neo ESS, SigenFlux heat pumps, and SigenAgent AI technology to support its 'AI in All' strategy.

SMPL.title: ROSEN, A LONGSTANDING FIRM, Encourages The Simply Good Foods Company Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action – SMPL
SMPL.summary: Rosen Law Firm is seeking lead plaintiffs for a securities class action lawsuit against The Simply Good Foods Company (SMPL) for allegedly making false statements regarding its OWYN acquisition. The lawsuit claims the company failed to disclose operational failures, product quality issues, margin erosion, and failed integration of the acquired assets. The lead plaintiff deadline is October 13, 2026.

HDB.title: HDFC Bank Shareholder Alert: ClaimsFiler Reminds Investors With Losses In Excess Of $100,000 Of Lead Plaintiff Deadline In Class Action Lawsuit Against HDFC Bank Limited - HDB
HDB.summary: HDFC Bank Limited faces a securities class action lawsuit for allegedly failing to disclose material information between July 2023 and May 2026. The Indian Express reported that HDFC disguised approximately Rs 45 crore ($4.7 million) as marketing expenses to pay above-market interest rates to Maharashtra State Road Development Corporation. An internal investigation identified over ten senior officials involved, including CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan. The stock fell 4.1% on the news. Investors with losses exceeding $100,000 have until October 13, 2026 to file lead plaintiff applications.

HDB.title: HDB ALERT: HAGENS BERMAN, NATIONAL TRIAL ATTORNEYS, Encourages HDFC Bank Limited (NYSE: HDB) Investors to Contact its Legal Team Regarding Securities Fraud Class Action Lawsuit
HDB.summary: Hagens Berman has filed a securities fraud class action lawsuit against HDFC Bank Limited and its executives, alleging the bank concealed a scheme involving approximately Rs 45 crore ($4.7 million USD) in disguised payments to induce state deposits while providing above-market interest rates. The fraudulent practices allegedly violated RBI regulations and the bank's internal policies, resulting in overstated financials. The scheme surfaced following the resignation of the Chairman in March 2026 and an investigative report in May 2026, causing HDFC's stock to decline sharply. The class period covers July 17, 2023 to May 26, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of October 13, 2026.

HDB.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges HDFC Bank Limited Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
HDB.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against HDFC Bank Limited and certain officers for alleged securities law violations. The complaint alleges that HDFC Bank camouflaged payments as marketing spend to pay higher interest to a state firm to induce deposits, activities approved by senior management that likely violated regulations. This resulted in overstated interest income and operating expenses, making positive statements about the bank's business materially misleading.

PMA.title: Ming Shing Group Holdings Limited Announces Closing of the Acquisition of Meals Through Seasons Limited and Issuance of Consideration Shares and Unsecured Convertible Promissory Notes

AVEX.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges AEVEX Corp. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm

PRCT.title: BE DEADLINE: ROSEN, GLOBAL INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Bloom Energy Corporation Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - BE

PRCT.title: HTZ IMPORTANT DEADLINE: ROSEN, GLOBAL INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - HTZ

PRCT.title: PROCEPT BioRobotics Corporation Securities Fraud Class Action Result of Undisclosed Inventory Issues and approximately 18% Stock Decline - Investors may Contact Reed Kathrein at Hagens Berman Sobol Shapiro LLP
PRCT.summary: A securities class action has been filed against PROCEPT BioRobotics for allegedly withholding information about handpiece sales practices. The stock declined approximately 48% from August 2025 to February 2026 as the company made successive downward revisions and eventually disclosed the inventory issues.

However, agriculture margins narrowed significantly due to tariffs and lower volumes, while construction sales advanced 12% but profitability declined. The company raised its 2026 industrial outlook but faces ongoing challenges from tariffs, South American market weakness, and declining cash flow. Estimates have trended downward since the earnings release, and the stock holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

HSY.title: Hershey's Pricing Holds Firm: Can Volume Pressure Ease From Here?

ZLDPY.title: Correction: Zealand Pharma - Transactions related to share buy-back program (week 35, 2026)
ZLDPY.summary: Zealand Pharma issued a correction to its share buy-back program announcement for week 35 (August 24-28, 2026), updating transaction dates in the reporting table. During this period, the company repurchased 136,000 shares at an average price of DKK 318.99, bringing total accumulated repurchases to 2,863,000 shares (approximately 5.22% of share capital) valued at DKK 868.6 million under the DKK 1.3 billion program.

BRLS.title: Borealis Foods Inc. Receives Expected Notification of Deficiency from Nasdaq Related to Delayed Filing of Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for Fiscal Quarter Ended June 30, 2026
BRLS.summary: Borealis Foods Inc. received a notice from Nasdaq on August 26, 2026, indicating non-compliance with listing rules due to delayed filing of its Q2-2026 Form 10-Q. The delay was caused by the need to review the accounting treatment of a previously disclosed Conversion Agreement subject to shareholder approval. The company has until October 26, 2026, to submit a compliance plan and until February 16, 2027, to regain compliance. The notice has no immediate effect on the company's listing or trading status.

WFC.title: Major Banks Make a Move Into Stablecoins: What Should Investors Watch?
WFC.summary: A consortium of 21 major global banks including Citigroup, Bank of America, Goldman Sachs, and Wells Fargo plans to launch a U.S. dollar-denominated stablecoin in the first half of 2027, enabled by the new GENIUS Act regulatory framework. While this represents a long-term strategic opportunity for the participating banks, it poses a competitive threat to Circle Internet Group's USDC stablecoin, which currently dominates the market with $73.3B in circulation.

DK.title: California Resources Completes $63M Acquisition of Crimson Midstream
DK.summary: California Resources Corporation (CRC) has completed its $63 million acquisition of Crimson Midstream Holdings from CorEnergy Infrastructure Trust. The deal expands CRC's midstream infrastructure in California, providing greater control over oil transportation to higher-value markets and improving operational flexibility. CRC is also evaluating Crimson's pipeline corridors for potential CO2 transportation as part of its carbon management strategy. Near-term financial contribution is expected to be modest, with Q3 2026 G&A and capital expenses estimated at $1-2 million each.

DK.title: DK Stock Rallies 59.5% in 3 Months: Is There More Upside Ahead?
DK.summary: Delek US Holdings (DK) reported strong Q2 2026 results with adjusted net income of $343.9M and refining EBITDA of $566.2M, driven by improved crack spreads and operational efficiency.
